en.quote: In 2024, we plan to launch production of 20 import-substituted [SSJ100] aircraft a year, with domestically made PD-8 engines.
en.head: Serial production with PD-8 engines had not begun by 2024.
en.body: Rostec supplied the first PD-8 engines for SJ-100 testing in February 2025. An aircraft built using serial-production technologies with those engines first flew in September 2025. Production of 20 such aircraft annually therefore had not begun in 2024. This concerns the production deadline, not the number delivered in 2026.

osrc.t: Rostec, first PD-8 engines for the SJ-100
Rostec, SJ-100 maiden flight with PD-8 engines
